benefits.name: Cell Phone Protection
benefits.description: Coverage against damage or theft of an eligible cell phone when the monthly mobile bill is paid with the card.
benefits.terms: Requires paying the monthly wireless bill with the card. Visa benefit; see the Guide to Benefits for coverage limits and deductible.

benefits.name: Visa Roadside Dispatch
benefits.description: Pay-per-use roadside assistance referral service available 24/7.
benefits.terms: Service is arranged at a set fee per dispatch; the fee is not waived by the card.

benefits.name: Emergency Card Replacement
benefits.description: Emergency replacement of a lost or stolen card while traveling.

earningRates.terms: Unlimited 2% Cash Back on all eligible purchases. No rotating spend categories, no caps, as long as the account is open and in good standing.
